name: Mei Zhang
bio:
Mei Zhang's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, stemming from a childhood fascination with intricate kites and their aerodynamic properties. This interest led her to study materials science, focusing on composites and their applications in high-stress environments. After graduating, she worked for a company that manufactured components for the aviation industry, honing her skills in crafting lightweight, durable structures. 

Her transition to motorsport was driven by a desire for greater creative freedom and the fast-paced nature of racing. At Hot Car Competições, Mei takes a meticulous approach to her work, believing that even the smallest imperfection can impact performance. She's known for her ability to quickly identify and address weaknesses in composite designs, and her willingness to experiment with new materials and techniques to gain a competitive edge. Mei is invaluable to the team, always pushing for innovation and improvement in the carbon fiber composition.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly bobbed with subtle gray streaks
physical.description: Mei is a petite woman with a focused gaze and kind smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and material composition notes.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on surfaces to test their resonance.
Insists on personally inspecting every composite component under a specific wavelength of UV light.
